text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sniff… sob… Can I really do it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't cry. Remember what you said about finding the legendary blade?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This all started a few hours ago while I was walking past the station…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You want to help out Opera O but don't have the confidence?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: She said she's going to do a new opera performance that requires a lot of research. So I offered to help…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But. looking at the map… I don't know if I'll be able to reach all the destinations!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And that's why you're here crying alone? Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I know I said I'd help, but I didn't expect to be dragged all the way here!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What exactly is this "legendary blade" research anyway?!
choice_data_list: Well, you can't bail on her now.
Well, you can't bail on her now.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm sorry! I'm sorry! But… there are children looking forward to the performance!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You don't need to convince me. I already know you're not turning back… Let's just get this over with!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, they set out to find the legendary blade.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! It's shaking! We're so high up! I don't like thiiiis!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't look down. Keep your eyes in front of you while you walk.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But do we have to walk so fast? Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaah! My shoes are soaked! So are my butt and back!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pull yourself together. You're the one who decided to see this through!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hey? That thing over there… is that…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No way. Is this the legendary…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I managed to get all the information I needed without a hitch! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That map was pretty useless, wasn't it? What was Opera O thinking? Geez…
choice_data_list: It took us on a huge detour…
It took us on a huge detour…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm… I'm really sorry about that! It's my fault for making you do so much…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There's no need to apologize for something I chose to do of my own accord… I'll see you later.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-but… Oh! Hold on for just a second!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Can I buy you a tasty drink as thanks? You know the commercial, right? "When you're feelin' extra drained, gotta have a honeyade! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No thanks.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't need it. Your words are thanks enough.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-but! I couldn't… How about something besides a drink? An ice cream, or a grilled carrot? Or maybe…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine. Really. You're the one who put in the effort, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But, but… you helped…

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Hey! We knew that was you, Doto! Are you preparing for today's opera?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, they're from the local children's center. Opera O invited them to watch our show…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, hello, everyone. I actually just finished preparing. This nice lady here was helping me out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I didn't do anything. I just followed along.

text_block_list.name: Enthusiastic Boy
text_block_list.text: Wh-whooooaaa! You're like a superhero!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Girl
text_block_list.text: You came to Doto's rescue, but you're not even bragging about it! That's… so cooool!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-hold on…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-hold on…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …I only did what anyone should do.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Whooooa!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah, enough! Why did you have to go and say that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the children surround Admire Vega, she shoots me a resentful look.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Deal with what?
choice_data_list: Quickly, Ayabe Ranger! The city needs their hero!
Quickly, Ayabe Ranger! The city needs their hero!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You better get going! Thank you for protecting us, Ayabe Ranger!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Have you… done this before?
choice_data_list: I'm just going with the flow.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Keep it up and someone might come and scout you to be in their play.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we leave, I return Admire Vega's half-weary grumblings with a wry smile.
